# The downtime pack

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

A printable copy of the last snapshot, for when the system is down: beds by ward, the ED queue, pending moves and legal forms.

## What is on the screen

1. When it was taken. The pack is a copy from this time. It does not update by itself.
2. Pack totals. Beds ready, occupied and being made ready in this copy.
3. Print or save PDF. Prints every table in full, whichever one is open. Save the PDF to your service's approved downtime location.
4. New snapshot. The bed coordinator takes a new snapshot. Other desks see when the last one was taken.
5. Record an outage. Type when the system was down, from and to, then Save. Each ward then sees a catch-up card. No bed figure changes.
6. Packs not printed. For the coordinator: each ward whose last pack was never printed or is past the age the band names, with its last print.
7. Sections. Beds by ward, ED queue, pending movements and legal forms. Choose one to read it here.
8. Beds by ward. Each ward's beds by health service, with the ready count and totals.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
